dedupe_keys.name: 常滑市 gtfs schedule and real time transit data

description: 常滑市: GTFS schedule and real-time transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by 常滑市. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Chita, Aichi Prefecture, Japan, with real-time vehicle, trip or alert feeds. Coverage: Chita, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed and 3 GTFS Realtime feeds for this provider (Chita, Aichi Prefecture, Japan). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Fares V1, Feed Information, Headsigns, Location Types, Route Colors, Shapes, Translations. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. Note in the listing: 常滑北部・大野線、常滑北部・市役所線、常滑中部・市役所線、ボートレースとこなめ周遊線、常滑南部・上野間線、常滑南部・武豊線、スクール専用便（一般の方はご利用できません） It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
